displayName: Azure OpenAI Service: Restrict outbound network access
description: Denies Microsoft.CognitiveServices OpenAI accounts where restrictOutboundNetworkAccess is not true, limiting data exfiltration paths. Permitted destinations should be declared via allowedFqdnList. MCSB v2 NS-2.3, NS-7.1.

metadata.description: Enable or disable the execution of the policy.
